title: 36 Hours in Park City, Utah
abstract: Ambitious new hoteliers and chefs in Park City proper have injected new life and urban sophistication into the city of 7,400 people.

title: 36 Hours in Beijing
abstract: Beijing can feel chaotic and sprawling, especially as it races to finish Olympic construction before the Games begin. But there’s an ancient order to the place, a cosmology, and you can follow it.

title: 36 Hours in New Orleans
abstract: Barely two years after Hurricane Katrina, the city welcomes visitors with streetcar rides and impromptu parades, riverboat calliopes and sidewalk tap dancers.

title: 36 Hours in Singapore
abstract: Singapore may be clean, efficient and manicured, but the prosperous island-state knows how to get down and dirty, too.

title: 36 Hours in Sarasota, Fla.
abstract: This scrubbed, suntanned and artsy little town offers just enough of a city vibe to sustain great food and a little night life.
